items.headline: OpenAI: GPT-6 Astra averages 87% on code tasks in 20 languages including COBOL, Fortran, and Visual Basic
items.summary: OpenAI published MultiLangBench evaluations showing GPT-6 Astra passes 87.4% of code tests across 20 languages, up from 26.8% for GPT-5.6 Sol. COBOL migration accuracy with GPT-6.1 Sol jumps from 5.4% to 86.6%. OpenAI is open-sourcing the benchmark.
items.why: Enterprise systems worth trillions still run on COBOL and Fortran with a shrinking pool of expert programmers. A jump from 5% to 87% in automated COBOL migration could unlock legacy modernization that has waited decades for practical tooling.

items.headline: Leak: Microsoft eval configs swap GPT-5.6 Terra for GPT-6.1 Terra, hinting at a new mid-tier OpenAI model
items.summary: TestingCatalog reports 18 Microsoft evaluation configs changed from GPT-5.6 Terra to GPT-6.1 Terra. The Information says a new Terra model could arrive this month, positioned to outperform Sol at lower cost.

items.headline: Reports: Google staff internally testing a Gemini 4 build codenamed Carbon ahead of possible October launch
items.summary: The Information reports Google employees are testing a new Gemini 4 checkpoint codenamed Carbon. It is unclear whether Carbon will replace Argon or launch as a separate model. The Information says some model launches could slip into November.

items.headline: Report: Canadian publishers including Postmedia and Globe and Mail sue Anthropic over Claude training data
items.summary: The Neuron reports a coalition including Postmedia and The Globe and Mail filed a copyright lawsuit in Ontario alleging Anthropic used their content to train Claude without permission. The allegations have not been decided by a court.
